local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local points={{{{561.0039672851562,1988.1319580078125,6.0}},{{662.6249389648438,1887.8121337890625,40.0}},{{752.9625854492188,1819.8951416015625,46.0}},{{898.0115356445312,1761.0928955078125,24.0}},{{1076.7681884765625,1761.627685546875,22.0}},{{1366.8812255859375,1543.390380859375,0.0}}}}
local index=1
local timer=0
local started=false
local wasUse=false
local strike=0
local released=nil
local useStart=nil
local combat=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if core.isWorldPaused() then if started then print('CavernFight paused');print('CavernFight choice=stop') end;return end
 started=true
 local use=self.controls.use~=0
 if use and not wasUse then strike=strike+1;released=nil;useStart=core.getSimulationTime();print('CavernFight strike='..strike..' armed') end
 if use and useStart and core.getSimulationTime()-useStart>=0.6 then print('CavernFight strike='..strike..' charged') end
 if wasUse and not use then released=core.getSimulationTime() end
 if released and core.getSimulationTime()-released>=1 then print('CavernFight strike='..strike..' settled') end
 wasUse=use
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<0.1 then return end;timer=0
 if Actor.isDead(self) then print('CavernFight playerDead');print('CavernFight choice=stop');return end
 if Actor.getStance(self)==Actor.STANCE.Weapon then print('CavernFight weaponReady') end
 local npc=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x92c59))
 if not npc or not npc:isValid() or npc.cell.name~=self.cell.name then print('CavernFight absent');return end
 if Actor.isDead(npc) then print('CavernFight targetDead');print('CavernFight choice=stop');return end
 print('CavernFight choice=fight')
 local distance=(npc.position-self.position):length()
 local target,tag
 if distance<190 or Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current<80 then combat=true end
 if combat then print('CavernFight engaged') end
 if distance<95 then print('CavernFight inReach');print('CavernFight approach='..(strike+1)..' inReach') end
 if index<=#points and not combat then
  tag=tostring(index);local p=points[index];target=util.vector3(p[1],p[2],p[3]);local v=target-self.position
  if math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y)<25 then print('CavernFight reached='..tag);index=index+1;return end
 else tag='target';target=npc.position+util.vector3(0,0,90) end
 local v=target-self.position
 local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local angle=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y)
 local pitch=0
 if tag=='target' then local c=target-camera.getPosition();pitch=-math.atan2(c.z,math.sqrt(c.x*c.x+c.y*c.y)) end
 if math.abs(angle)<0.06 and math.abs(pitch-camera.getPitch())<0.05 then print('CavernFight ready='..tag) end
 print(string.format('CavernFight aim x=%d y=%d tag=%s distance=%.2f playerHP=%.2f targetHP=%.2f pos=%s target=%s',math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(angle*128+.5))),math.max(-80,math.min(80,math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*128+.5))),tag,distance,Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current,Actor.stats.dynamic.health(npc).current,tostring(self.position),tostring(npc.position)))
end}}}}
